sentences.text: Therefore, after careful examination of the matter, permission has been accorded to the Chief Engineer, Telugu Ganga Project, Tirupati Somasila Project to acquire the lands to an extent of ac.6.10 cents in Sy.Nos.15, 16, 19/3 in Muthukuru Village of Atluru(M), YSR Kadapa District

are within the water spread area of 212.285 sq.kms and below FRL (330 feet) of Somasila Project, duly following the provisions under the RFCTLARR Act, 2013 vide Government Memo No.ICD01/743/2021-LA, Water Resources Department, Dated 07.06.2022."

Earlier, on 20.12.2022, considering the submissions made on the basis of written instructions of the 3rd respondent, three months time was granted for completing the entire land acquisition process while observing that in the event, the order is not complied with by that date, the respondents 2 and 3 shall appear before this Court.

On 29.03.2023, after considering the submissions made by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition that the concerned officers would pass Award in terms of the earlier orders of this Court, the matter was directed to be listed on 26.04.2023 while observing that if the Award is not passed by the next date of adjournment, the 2nd respondent shall appear before this Court.
Page 3

On 26.04.2023, an application in I.A.No.1 of 2023 was considered by this Court, wherein dispense with the appearance of the 2nd respondent was sought for and by duly taking into account the submission made that the 2nd respondent is on medical leave, he was directed to appear on 26.04.2023 , if the Award is not passed by that date.
In terms of the Order dated 26.04.2023, the 2nd respondent appeared before this Court today.

At the time of considering the matter, an affidavit is filed by the 3rd respondent, wherein it is inter alia stated as follows:
"2. This respondent humbly submit that after receipt of the Order 29.03.2023 we sent a letter to the Requisition body who is Water Resource Department to furnish the valuation of property i.e., valuation of the land and structures to shown in the Award.

But we received a communication on 11.04.2023 from the Executive Engineer, Atmakur, Nellore District by stating that the said property is above FRL and there is no necessity to acquire scheduled Survey number lands mentioned in the writ petition and to that effect withdrawing the acquisition.
3. Under these circumstances this respondent unable to pass Award without having valuation reports with regard to the land and structures to mention in the Award.

4. I further submit that on 10.05.2023 again I received a communication from the Water Resources Department by stating that due to contrary statement made in the Sura Gangi Reddy vs K.S.Jawahar Reddy on 12 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78336916/
2 counter affidavit filed by Chief Engineer in the writ petition and the counter affidavit filed in the contempt application are not in uniformity.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence the Water Resources Department directed the District Collector to furnish a detailed report in this regard to resolve the problem within one month."

Along with the said affidavit, copies of the communications dated 10.05.2023 are enclosed, wherein in Memo No. ICD01/743/2021-LA, dated Page 4 10.05.2023, it is mentioned as follows:
"4.

In view of the two contradictory reports received from the Chief Engineer, TGP,
Tirupati, a detailed report is called for from the District Collector, YSR Kadapa vide reference 9th cited.
Therefore, the Special Collector (LA), GNSS, Kadapa is directed to place the above facts before the Hon'ble High Court of AP and seek one month time to resolve the issue."

Though the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition tried to impress upon this Court that in view of the communication received from the Water Resources Department informing that the lands in question are no longer needed for Somasila Project, the 3rd respondent is not in a position to pass the Award.
The stand taken by the Water Resources Department is contrary to record.

In this regard, it may be appropriate to refer to the Memo No.ICD01/743/2021-LA, dated 07.06.2022,
wherein it is mentioned in Para No.5 as follows:
"5. Government, after careful examination of the matter, hereby accord permission to acquire the lands to an extent of Ac.6.10 cents in Sy.Nos.15,16,19/3 in Muthukuru Village of Atluru(M), Kadapa District are within the water spread area of 212.285 sq.kms and below FRL(330 feet) of Somasila Project, duly following the provisions under the RFCTLARR Act, 2013."
Surprisingly, the very same Principal Secretary, who is signatory to the said Memo dated 07.06.2022 has issued the Memo dated 10.05.2023.
Be that as it may.

The fact remains that the Order dated 30.04.2021 passed in W.P.No.20861 of 2020 has not been implemented and the reasons sought to be placed before this Court cannot be countenanced, in the light of Page 5 the material, more particularly the counter-affidavit of the 1st respondent.

Having suffered an order, which has become final, the communications addressed by the Water Resources Department that the land is no longer required for the acquisition, itself amounts to willful defiance of the Order dated 30.04.2021.
List this case on 21.06.2023.

As sufficient time has already been granted for compliance of the orders of this Court at the request of respondents, it is made clear that in the event the Order dated 30.04.2021 in W.P.No.20861 of 2020 is not implemented by the date of next adjournment, all the respondents shall appear before this Court, without fail.
